name: Strict-Dominance Classes Are Closed Under Boolean Substitution
statement: If the nonempty outer class $C$ and test $T$ both have $\tau=0$, then every nonempty Boolean substitution $C\circ_iT$ has $\tau=0$, including equal outer sections and constant tests.
proof: For a proper nonconstant test and unequal outer sections, the exact defect law gives $d_{\rm dom}(C\circ_iT)=\max\{d_{\rm dom}(C),d_{\rm dom}(T)\}=0$. Equal sections reduce to a product with a cube; an empty or full test reduces to an outer section times a cube. Minor and product closure handle these boundary cases.
